decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication know-how and supports its direction toward binding mobile communication, so its own R&D can keep improving it.
Mobile PDF signing supports the online contract signing strategy and is close to existing competence, although as a narrow feature it may eventually be merged into broader signing offerings.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the conceptual backbone of the integrated security portfolio and makes the fullest use of the firm's deep security knowledge.

The email-to-app delivery robot relies on the firm's secure messaging competence, but its niche use case and weak market signals make it the most likely candidate for rework or later withdrawal, so for now the firm keeps it under review.
